mapper.select: select * from t_inventory_reservation where order_item_id = #{orderItemId} limit 1 for update
select * from t_inventory_reservation where order_no = #{orderNo} order by sku_id, id for update
mapper.update: update t_inventory_reservation set status = #{targetStatus}, committed_at = case when #{targetStatus} = 'COMMITTED' then current_timestamp else committed_at end, released_at = case when #{targetStatus} = 'RELEASED' then current_timestamp else released_at end, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and status = #{currentStatus}
